title: Update marts/schema.yml for the unpivoted marts
body:
## Parent

Part of #1 (Spec: Rewrite Downstream Marts for the Unpivoted fct_compute_offers)

## What to build

Update `marts/schema.yml` to document the four rewritten marts at offer×tier grain. Update the unique-key tests to include `tariff_tier_skey` (and `scheduled_tariff_window` for the trends mart). Add `not_null` and `accepted_values` tests on the tier-context columns (`tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `scheduled_tariff_window`). Replace all 7-tier column documentation with the generic tier-scoped columns.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All four mart definitions document the offer×tier grain
- [ ] Unique-key tests include `tariff_tier_skey` (and `scheduled_tariff_window` for the trends mart)
- [ ] `not_null` tests on `tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`
- [ ] `accepted_values` tests on `tariff_window_type` and `scheduled_tariff_window` (`low`/`high`)
- [ ] All 7-tier column docs replaced with generic tier-scoped columns

## Blocked by

- #2 (Rewrite mart_arbitrage_opportunities for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers)
- #3 (Rewrite mart_best_offers_by_gpu for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers)
- #4 (Rewrite mart_profitability_trends for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers)
- #5 (Rewrite mart_gpu_model_summary for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers)
